reader_summary.headline: This is Dom Cooke and today we are breaking down the PGA Tour.
reader_summary.overview: This is Dom Cooke and today we are breaking down the PGA Tour. Alongside the four standalone majors, the PGA Tour is the pinnacle of professional golf. It’s where the best players in the world earn their living and tee it up for their place in golfing history.

key_points.text: To break down the business behind the stars and action you see on the PGA Tour, I’m joined by Neil Schuster.
Editor’s note: this conversation was recorded before the field for this week’s inaugural LIV golf invitational event was announced.
